maddeler.e:
ننبغي (form VII)
# نَنْبَغِي (nanbaḡī) /nan.ba.ɣiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْبَغَى (inbaḡā)
# نَنْبَغِيَ (nanbaḡiya) /nan.ba.ɣi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْبَغَى (inbaḡā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
